verilog:
module mac (
    input clk,
    input reset,
    input clear,
    input en,
    input signed [7:0] a,
    input signed [8:0] b,  // Corrected to 9 bits for signed multiplication
    output reg signed [19:0] acc
);

always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (reset) begin
        acc <= 20'h0;
    end else begin
        if (clear) begin
            acc <= 20'h0;
        end else if (en) begin
            acc <= acc + (a * b);
        end
    end
end

endmodule
